case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: 1.4404 bar: price basis and contract proposal
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation. Contract ctr:4600070740 specifies 60-day payment terms; please retain that basis for renewal. Scorecard sc:70740@2026Q3 records 81.0% on-time delivery, so reliable fulfilment remains an important consideration.

Could you provide the alloy surcharge in €/kg separately from the base price, and explain which cost components are already covered by that surcharge? What savings could a 24-month commitment unlock?

We propose €5.60/kg with a fixed price and 60-day payment, offering a 24-month commitment in return. Alternatively, we can consider a symmetric, narrowly defined alloy adjustment at a lower starting price.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. The alloy surcharge covers the raw material costs associated with AS-14404, while the base price encompasses processing, energy, and overheads.

We can agree to the 24-month commitment and 60-day payment terms, utilizing the AS-14404 index to manage material volatility. In recognition of the extended commitment and indexation, we can offer a revised base price of €5.80 per unit.

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: 1.4404 bar: revised price and alloy adjustment
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for the reduction and clarification. Contract ctr:4600070740 specifies 60-day payment terms, which we propose retaining.

Could you confirm that €5.80/kg is the complete starting price, including the alloy surcharge, rather than a base price with an additional surcharge? Would a 36-month commitment allow a further reduction?

We can move our indexed proposal to €5.55/kg for 24 months, or offer 36 months at €5.50/kg. Both retain the 5% deadband. Alternatively, please consider €5.65/kg fixed for 24 months. Any index adjustment should apply symmetrically to increases and decreases, without duplicate surcharge recovery.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Renewal: price reduction for longer commitment
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for confirming the all-in starting price and symmetric adjustment. Your 36-month option currently carries the same price as the 24-month option; could you quantify the additional saving available for the longer commitment?

Contract ctr:4600070740 specifies 60-day payment terms, which remain our preferred basis.

We propose €5.55/kg indexed for 24 months. For 36 months, we could shorten payment to 45 days in exchange for €5.50/kg. Alternatively, could you offer €5.60/kg fixed for 24 months, avoiding index administration for both parties?

Please retain the complete starting-price basis without a separate alloy surcharge.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. We always strive to provide you with the best service and reliable material supplies for your production needs.

Regarding our discussion, this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We cannot offer a fixed price for a 24-month term, as the indexation is necessary to manage material volatility for both parties. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

We therefore maintain our offer of €5.60 per unit for a 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms and the AS-14404 index. Specifically, our offer stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
